name: Glass Hearts
source:
The year is 197X.

You've just moved to Glass Shard Beach in your senior year of high school, and you are certain that this will be the worst thing that ever has and will happen to you. You're in a new and unfamiliar town, your parents are divorced, and worst of all: your high school dreams of going to homecoming with a date will undoubtedly be crushed.

At least, that's what you believe until you meet the Pines twins. 

[From [url=https://spitefulstudios.itch.io/glass-hearts-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
时间是197X年。

你刚刚在高中高年级搬到玻璃碎片海滩，并且你确信这将是你曾经遇到过并将发生在你身上的最糟糕的事情。你来到了一个陌生的新城镇，你的父母离婚了，最糟糕的是：你高中时与约会对象一起回家的梦想无疑将破灭。

至少，在你遇到派恩斯双胞胎之前你是这么认为的。
